name: ihp-sg13
description: IHP SG13G2 and SG13CMOS5L low-voltage and high-voltage MOS devices (PSP 103, OSDI).

ngspice.size_unit_source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moslv_mod.lib (the subcircuit defaults are w=0.35u l=0.34u; the model files set no .option scale)

r.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.doc/doc/SG13G2_os_process_spec.pdf (2.9 Rhigh: sheet resistance 1360 ohm/sq target); ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerRES.lib (rsh_rhigh = 1360); ihp-sg13g2/libs.doc/doc/SG13G2_os_layout_rules.pdf (6.4 Rhi.a: min. GatPoly width 0.50 um)

ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.doc/doc/SG13CMOS5L_os_process_spec.pdf (2.2.3 Rhigh: sheet resistance 1360 ohm/sq target); ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerRES.lib (rsh_rhigh = 1360); ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.doc/doc/SG13CMOS5L_os_layout_rules.pdf (6.3 Rhi.a: min. GatPoly width 0.50 um)

c.source: ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/docs/precheck_rules.md (CMOS5L.FORB.MIM: the MIM layer is prohibited, so the densest capacitor is a MOM capacitor); ihp-sg13cmos5l/libs.tech/ngspice/models/cap_cmomf.lib (areacap = 0.372 + (mmax - mmin) x 0.305 fF/um2; Metal1 to Metal4: 1.287 fF/um2; a simulation-derived estimate, not silicon data)

ng.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moslv_mod.lib (ng is passed to the device as nf)

m.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moslv_mod.lib (m is passed to the device as mult)

ng.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moslv_mod.lib (ng is passed to the device as nf)

m.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moslv_mod.lib (m is passed to the device as mult)

ng.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moshv_mod.lib (ng is passed to the device as nf)

m.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moshv_mod.lib (m is passed to the device as mult)

ng.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moshv_mod.lib (ng is passed to the device as nf)

m.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/models/sg13g2_moshv_mod.lib (m is passed to the device as mult)

main.description: the main rule table of ihp-sg13g2.drc, without the extra rules (sg13g2_maximal.drc) and the density rules (density.drc)
main.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/run_drc.py (main runs the table main always, density.drc unless --no_density, sg13g2_maximal.drc unless --disable_extra_rules; run_check writes <layout>_<topcell>_<table>.lyrdb in --run_dir; check_drc_results returns 1 when the report has violations and 0 when it has none; run_parallel_run logs '<table> generated an exception' when a table fails); ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/README.md (Usage)

full.description: all rules of the PDK script: the main table, the extra rules (sg13g2_maximal.drc) and the density rules (density.drc)
full.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/run_drc.py (check_drc_results merges more than one report into <layout>_<topcell>_full.lyrdb and deletes the partial reports; it returns 1 when the report has violations and 0 when it has none); ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/tech/drc/README.md (Usage)

lvs.netlist_format: SPICE (.spice, .cdl or .cir) with one .subckt per cell; MOS devices as M lines with the device name of the PDK as the model, for example 'M1 d g s b sg13_lv_nmos w=1u l=0.5u ng=1 m=1'. The deck reads it with its own reader (rule_decks/custom_reader.lvs).
lvs.description: the stock LVS of the PDK script run_lvs.py (sg13g2.lvs), with schematic simplification on (the default)
lvs.source: ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/tech/lvs/run_lvs.py (the database <layout>.lvsdb and the extracted netlist <layout>_extracted.cir in --run_dir); ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/tech/lvs/sg13g2.lvs (it logs 'ERROR : Netlists don't match' or 'INFO : Congratulations! Netlists match.'; the script exits with 0 in both cases); ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/klayout/tech/lvs/README.md (Usage)
